import html from typing import List # Predefined template for forum posts FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
{options} """ def _escape_markdown(text: str) -> str: """ Very small markdown sanitizer that escapes HTML and converts a few common Markdown constructs into safe plain text. """ # Escape HTML entities first escaped = html.escape(text) # Convert Markdown list markers to plain text bullets (simple approach) lines = escaped.splitlines() converted_lines = [] for line in lines: stripped = line.lstrip() if stripped.startswith(('-', '*', '+')): # Replace list marker with a bullet converted_lines.append(f"• {stripped[1:].lstrip()}") else: converted_lines.append(line) return "\n".join(converted_lines) def build_forum_post( title: str, post_body: str, options_list: List[str] ) -> str: """ Construct a sanitized forum post with a header, body and options list. Parameters ---------- title : str The title or subject line of the forum post. post_body : str The main content or body of the forum post. options_list : list[str] A collection of user-provided options or discussion points in markdown format. Returns ------- str The sanitized and formatted forum post as an HTML string. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the required arguments are missing or not of the correct type. """ # Basic validation if not isinstance(title, str): raise ValueError("title must be a string") if not isinstance(post_body, str): raise ValueError("post_body must be a string") if not isinstance(options_list, list) or not all(isinstance(o, str) for o in options_list): raise ValueError("options_list must be a list of strings") # Escape and sanitize the title safe_title = html.escape(title) # Sanitize the body (allowing only a minimal set of HTML tags) safe_body = html.escape(post_body) # Build the options list as an unordered HTML list if options_list: sanitized_options = [_escape_markdown(opt) for opt in options_list] list_items = "\n".join(f"
  • {opt}
    • " for opt in sanitized_options) options_html = f"\n
      \n{list_items}\n
    " else: options_html = "" # Format the final post formatted_post = FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, body=safe_body, options=options_html ) return formatted_post.strip()
